front.title: External-Registry DNS Resource Record Types: UNECE and ISO

abstract.t: This document defines two DNS resource record types, UNECE and ISO, which convey numeric values paired with codes drawn from registries maintained by external standards organizations: the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE) and the International Organization for Standardization. Neither proposed RRTYPE duplicates the external registries into IANA registries; each carries codes verbatim and uses the semantics defined by the external maintainer. The document specifies presentation and wire formats for both types, records the assignment of two decimal RRTYPE identifiers under the Expert Review process of BCP 42, and suggests a common design pattern that may serve as a model for future RRTYPEs seeking to make external registries usable from the DNS without duplication.
